eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Duval, FL; at 2:10 PM on AUG 29, 2023 Effective until 6:10 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Express transportation is available at Baldwin Middle School (291 Mill St W, Baldwin, FL 32234) via JTA Bus to the hurricane evacuation shelter at Chaffee Trail Elementary School until 10 p.m. Transportation will resume tomorrow at 6 a.m. until weather conditions deteriorate.
